mainEntity.name: Does Website Entity Optimization improve local search visibility in New York City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Website Entity Optimization significantly enhances local search visibility, including in New York City. By clearly defining local entities such as your business name, address, phone number (NAP data), services offered, and geographical relevance through structured data, search engines can better understand your local presence. This helps your business appear in local pack results, Google Maps, and targeted local searches by users in specific areas within New York City.
